name: Skulk Rock Clean-up
summary: Sludges and oozes overrun the Horde's old positions around Skulk Rock. Fraggar Thundermantle at Aerie Peak wants them cleared, for the Wildhammers have plans for the ground.

sections.title: A Matter of Territory
sections.body: The Wildhammers remember the past more than their brothers in Ironforge do. Fraggar Thundermantle says friends are made here by getting your hands dirty. The Horde left its positions around Skulk Rock in the Hinterlands, and sludges and oozes have overrun them. The Wildhammers have plans for that ground, but first the infestation must be thinned.

sections.title: Clearing the Ground
sections.body: Slay ten green sludges and ten jade oozes. Then return to Fraggar at Aerie Peak with your report.

aliases: who gives skulk rock clean up
faq.answer: Fraggar Thundermantle is a Wildhammer at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands. He wants Skulk Rock cleared.

faq.q: Why do the Wildhammers want Skulk Rock cleared?
faq.answer: The Horde left its positions around Skulk Rock, and sludges and oozes have overrun them. The Wildhammers have plans for the area, but first the infestation must be thinned.

faq.q: What creatures dwell at Skulk Rock?
faq.answer: Green sludges and jade oozes have overrun the old Horde positions at Skulk Rock.

faq.q: Why does Fraggar bring up Ironforge?
faq.answer: Fraggar says the Wildhammers remember the past more than their brothers in Ironforge do. He says friends are made here by getting your hands dirty.
